cash.archiveNote: Year {{year}}: revenue, expenses and transfers come from the archive; tuition payments come from the snapshot frozen when this year was closed. If it was never closed, the current student records are shown.
cash.surplusHint: Surplus: more money in than out
cash.deficitHint: Deficit: more money out than in
cash.footer: Tuition payments come from the payment journal, which records every movement and its cancellations. Payments made before it was put into service are rebuilt from the student records — without duplicates, but without cancellations or author. Salaries do not appear here: a payslip carries a month, not a payment date. A box ticked by mistake then unticked with the reason “data-entry error” stays listed (struck through, with its explanation) but counts neither as money in nor out; a refund, however, is money out. The “Year” view counts everything recorded in the year being viewed, whatever its date (September re-enrolments included), like the Report.
